This notebook runs the full pipeline from one input data layer. All numbers,
tables, and figures come from the canonical objects built in `R/data_layer.R`
(`prs`, `reviews`, `commits`, `panel`, `panel_est`, `telem`, `roles`,
`repo_cohort`). No data is distributed with this repository; see `README.md` for the
input schema, or run `R/make_synthetic_data.R` to create a synthetic dataset
(numbers computed from synthetic data are meaningless).

**Automation rule:** a PR is excluded *iff* its `is_automated` flag is `TRUE`; a
review event counts as non-human *iff* its `is_automated` flag is `TRUE` (the
descriptive review series also treat `is_templated` events as automated).
